title: A source title with a typographic hyphen crashed the tools on a Windows console

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project against the live indexes

observed_failure: verify_citations.py stopped with UnicodeEncodeError when it printed a title containing U+2010 to a cp1252 console, after the network work was done and before the registry was written.
expected_behavior: Printing never stops a tool: characters the console cannot show are replaced, and the files are written in UTF-8 as before.

resolution.summary: every v0.5 tool sets errors=replace on stdout and stderr at start (rce_common.safe_stdout)

lessons: Live titles contain characters synthetic fixtures never do; test output on a narrow console encoding.
